reviewOutcome: Public ALKIS parcel polygons are verified near the WUP point; serial qualification is required before any adapter or runtime admission.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and German first-party discovery queries were recorded. LVermGeo Sachsen-Anhalt open-data documentation, WFS capabilities, a bounded anonymous GetFeature request, and the Magdeburg municipal planning viewer were checked. The WFS returned three parcel MultiSurface features in EPSG:25832; only native idflurst and transformed geometry were retained.
cityOrLocalCustodian: LVermGeo Sachsen-Anhalt is the evidenced state cadastral custodian and provider of the public ALKIS WFS. The Magdeburg municipal viewer is evidenced as a planning map only; no municipal cadastral API custody was established. State-level agency evidence is not a claim that the city operates the service.
schemaAndCrs: WFS capabilities reported ave:Flurstueck with default CRS EPSG:25832. The returned features used native idflurst/oid identity and GML MultiSurface geometry; retained GeoJSON uses EPSG:4326 coordinates and exactly one id property per feature.
uncertainty: The bounded response is a sample, not a completeness claim. Exact-point hits or misses, map extent limits, timeouts, login walls, or unusable UI would not prove citywide absence; none were used as absence evidence. The public WFS response and source pages do not establish legal currency, citywide completeness, or runtime integration suitability.
integrationDisposition: Research packet only; not source integration or admission. No registry, catalog, runtime, queue, or global report files were changed.
